# Parity Requirements Checklist: Subagent Screen Parity

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality validation ("unit tests for English") for the subagent screen parity feature — tests whether the 017 requirements corpus (spec.md, plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, quickstart.md, contracts/ui-parity-contract.md) is complete, clear, consistent, and measurable. This checklist does NOT test implementation behavior.
**Created**: 2026-08-22
**Feature**: specs/017-please-modify-joey/spec.md

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are non-functional requirements (rendering performance non-degradation, input latency) given an explicit ID'd section in spec.md rather than existing only as prose assumptions? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are requirements defined for terminals without clipboard support (OSC52 unavailable) when the FR-006 copy action is invoked? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 - Does FR-011 enumerate a closed list of "all spawn surfaces" (delegate_task, OMO Atlas, /hypercode, dispatch_batch) and state how surfaces added in the future are handled? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK004 - Does the spec define search behavior for the no-match case and for wrap-around/reaching the end within a pane, beyond the match indicator? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements specified for terminal/pane resize while the focused subagent view is active? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the minimum terminal geometry (≥96 columns, currently only in quickstart.md) stated as a normative requirement in spec.md? [Completeness, Gap, quickstart.md]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is the clarification defining "identical" (functional + visual, content differs) applied as a single defined term consistently across FR-002, FR-005, FR-006, and FR-009? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK008 - Does FR-010 enumerate exactly which state dimensions must be preserved on view switch (scroll, expand, search, stats view), or is "state" left implicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are quantified limits recorded only in research.md (e.g., 200-entry transcript scale, search/output caps) promoted into normative spec requirements where they affect user-visible behavior? [Clarity, Gap, research.md]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the recovery path for a disappeared subagent (Ctrl+L per decision D9) specified in spec.md itself, including what state the orchestrator returns to? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, research.md D9]
- [ ] CHK011 - Does FR-012 define the artifact and format of the "repeatable acceptance checks" (script, checklist, or test suite) so that completeness can be judged objectively? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 - Is the FR-007 wording ("highlighting matches") reconciled with research decision D5 (match-indicator only, no in-transcript text highlighting), or does the spec text need updating to match the decided interpretation? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007, research.md D5]
- [ ] CHK013 - Do the quickstart scenarios S1–S11 plus the contract acceptance map collectively cover all thirteen functional requirements (FR-001–FR-013) without omission? [Consistency, Coverage, contracts/ui-parity-contract.md §7]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the keymap contract's Status vocabulary ("works today" / "retargeted") sufficient to express partially-implemented keys, and is every FR-002/FR-004 key accounted for in the table? [Consistency, contracts/ui-parity-contract.md §2]
- [ ] CHK015 - Does the Constitution Check in plan.md evaluate or explicitly justify skipping each constitution principle (currently only Principles 0 and VIII appear in its gate list)? [Consistency, plan.md §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the empty-transcript styling edge case specified consistently with the FR-009 chrome requirements (header, scrollbar, badge behavior when a pane is empty)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 - Can SC-003 ("no visual diff" in side-by-side review) be verified objectively — is the comparison method (manual, screenshot, glyph-level) specified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is SC-002's "100% success" for orchestrator-only testers defined operationally (participant count, task list, pass condition)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the performance non-degradation acceptance measurable — does plan.md state a concrete budget rather than "same complexity class" (Constitution VIII requires explicit budgets for perf-sensitive paths)? [Measurability, Gap, plan.md]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is SC-004's "100% state preservation" specific about which state dimensions are observed and how preservation is detected? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are alternate-flow requirements beyond the maximized-surface reachability rule documented — e.g., invoking orchestrator-level actions while a subagent pane is focused? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are recovery scenarios complete: streaming while scrolled up, search active during subagent disappearance, and expand in progress during disappearance? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are concurrent-arrival scenarios (rapid output from the subagent) addressed for every interaction (scroll, search, copy, viewer), not only during expand/collapse? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 - Are the edge cases assigned stable IDs (like FR/SC) so acceptance mapping and future tests can reference them traceably? [Traceability, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 - For the huge-tool-output bounding edge case, is the bound itself (and whether it is user-visible) specified as a normative requirement? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 - Are input-latency and per-frame allocation budgets for the focused view quantified anywhere in the requirements corpus? [Gap, plan.md]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the zero-new-dependencies constraint (decision D12) recorded as a normative requirement so that adding a dependency would be an explicit spec change? [Completeness, research.md D12]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 - Is the assumption "no on-disk/CLI changes (to be confirmed in planning)" formally closed by a corresponding statement in plan.md, with the confirmation recorded? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, plan.md]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are the assumptions assigned IDs for traceability into plan and (future) tasks, as edge cases and assumptions are currently unnumbered? [Traceability, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the "reuse orchestrator bindings" assumption validated against the keymap contract's retarget list without conflicts? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, contracts/ui-parity-contract.md §2]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK031 - Does the spec resolve whether mouse hit-testing in the focused view targets the same regions and produces the same outcomes as on the orchestrator screen? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the internal-only status of the new TuiAction::CopyPaneItem variant (no public API/config/on-disk surface change) documented as an explicit scope statement sufficient for the backward-compatibility review? [Ambiguity, data-model.md]
